title: Read without taking ownership
summary: Rust: Read without taking ownership. Borrow a different name.
introduction: A reference borrows a value. It lets code read the value while its owner keeps it.
learningObjectives: Read without taking ownership with Rust

blocks.text: Install stable Rust. Save each example as lesson.rs, run rustc lesson.rs, then run the created program.

blocks.title: Read without taking ownership

blocks.text: &name creates a shared reference. It borrows without moving the text, so both borrowed and name can read Asha.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A reference must not outlive the value it points to.
